name: MS_Multiple User Login Attempt from Same Source - PassSpray
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: MS_Multiple User Login Attempt from Same Source - PassSpray
// Vendor: Microsoft EntraID
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with MS_Multiple User Login Attempt from Same Source - PassSpray.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: CREDENTIAL_ACCESS
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0006 - Credential Access
// Technique: T1110.003 - Brute Force: Password Spraying

dataset = msft_azure_raw
| filter operationName = "Sign-in activity" and category = "SignInLogs"
| alter result_code = to_integer(resultType),
        result_desc = resultDescription,
        user_dst = properties -> userPrincipalName,
        appDisplayName = properties -> appDisplayName,
        userDisplayName = properties -> userDisplayName,
        userAgent = properties -> userAgent,
        OS = json_extract_scalar(properties, "$.deviceDetail.operatingSystem"),
        result = trim(arrayindex(regextract(properties, "result\":\"([^,]+)"), 0), "\"")
| iploc callerIpAddress loc_country,
        loc_asn_org
//| filter result_code != 0
| comp earliest(_time) as FirstEventTime,
       latest(_time) as LatestEventTime,
       values(userDisplayName) as username,
       values(user_dst) as user_dst,
       values(appDisplayName) as server,
       values(result_code) as result_code,
       values(result_desc) as result_desc,
       values(userAgent) as user_agent,
       values(loc_country) as country,
       values(loc_asn_org) as org,
       values(OS) as OS,
       values(result) as result,
       count() as matched_events by _time,
       callerIpAddress
| filter array_length(user_dst) >= 10
| alter aggregation_criteria = "ildestinationuser",
        duplicate_alert_count = subtract(floor(divide(matched_events, 5)), 1),
        event_time = format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", _time)
description: Múltiplas tentativas de autenticação malsucedidas provenientes da mesma origem, direcionadas a cinco ou mais contas de usuário.
alert_name: MS_Multiple User Login Attempt from Same Source - PassSpray
alert_description: Foram detectadas múltiplas tentativas de autenticação malsucedidas originadas do país $loc_country , partindo do endereço IP $callerIpAddress , direcionadas a cinco ou mais contas distintas. Entre os usuários impactados estão $user_dst ( $userDisplayName ), utilizando o agente de acesso $userAgent. Esse comportamento pode indicar atividade de força bruta ou movimentação lateral em tentativa de acesso não autorizado.
